actions.reason: C0004 shows coherent biological support from RNA (7 significant pathways, including pancreas beta cells) and CNV (4 significant continuous features on chr7 and chr20), with WXS showing a nominal PBRM1 trend. Cross-modal consistency is moderate with positive WSI and RNA silhouettes and high patient support. No significant technical confounders at set level. This is the strongest set with multiple independent support sources.

C0001 has RNA pathway support but WXS and CNV are not significant after FDR. Cross-modal consistency is weak with low silhouettes and many patients with zero support. No supported split or merge, and no available extra evidence. The single-modality support is insufficient for accept, and no other action is justified.

C0002 has only one significant RNA pathway (EMT) and no significant WXS or CNV findings. Cross-modal consistency is weak with low patient support. No supported split or merge, and no available extra evidence. Single-modality support is insufficient for accept.

C0003 has no significant biological findings in any modality after FDR correction. Cross-modal consistency is moderate in WSI but not supported by other modalities. No supported split or merge, and no available extra evidence. Insufficient evidence for accept.

C0005 has RNA pathway support but WXS and CNV are not significant after FDR. Cross-modal consistency is weak with low silhouettes. No supported split or merge, and no available extra evidence. Single-modality support is insufficient for accept.

C0006 has RNA pathway support and a suggestive BAP1 trend, but the set has a significant technical confounder (CJ site enrichment, q=0.049). Cross-modal consistency is weak with many patients having zero support. The technical confounder undermines biological interpretation, and no supported split or merge exists.

C0007 has no significant biological findings in any modality after FDR correction. It has multiple significant technical confounders (site, manufacturer, scanner, phase, slice thickness). Cross-modal consistency is weak. The technical confounding dominates and no supported split or merge exists.
